title: sync script: mixed code+.beads conflicts dead-end to manual, contradicting the :77-80 design comment
description: Reviewer kimi-k3 pass 3.2. CONFLICT_N (:285) counts .beads unmerged entries, so one code conflict + one store conflict never enters llm_semantic_merge; and even if called, :132 requires zero unmerged after 'git add -- $files' but the deliberately-excluded .beads conflicts remain → return 1. normalize_merge_store_entries (the canonical .beads handler) only runs after return 0. Legacy branches carrying .beads commits always dead-end to manual. Fix: exclude store entries from CONFLICT_N, or make :132 treat only non-.beads unmerged entries as failure.
